capabilities: Drag time blocks onto day, week and month boards
Store time entries in task frontmatter
Track day, week and month totals
Export selected tasks and date ranges to CSV
Create dedicated time entry notes for individual blocks
extras: Detailed controls, commands and settings are documented in a built-in guide (question mark in the task panel or the Open Chronoboard guide command) rather than the README.
problem: Obsidian has no visual, drag-and-drop time tracking that schedules tasks as blocks on time boards and stores the time data in Markdown.

relations.evidence: Chronoboard works well with TaskNotes-style task notes, but it is not tied to Jira, TaskNotes

summary: Gantt-style timeboard that turns Markdown tasks into draggable time blocks on day, week and month boards, writing time entries into task frontmatter.
